pipeline: improve_candidates.py: rewrite under strict rubric (specific, verifiable, verbatim evidence)
build_cross_page_eval.py: one verbatim span per page + why_both_pages
ablate_cross_page.py: keep only items neither page A nor page B can answer
verify_candidates.py: mechanical gate (verbatim evidence coverage, generic-question filter, yes/no filter, dedup, per-page grounding) + quota-balanced selection across papers
